summary: read_job now raises RuntimeError('Job metadata has an invalid status: <path>') when status is present and not a str, while a missing status is still allowed. Every job reader (status <id>, wait, cancel, continue via approvals.py:99, the worker at jobs.py:360/395/414, launch at jobstore.py:354, prune's selection pass) goes through read_job, so each one now hits the guard, and the CLI turns the error into the ERROR envelope with exit 1. list_jobs now calls read_job(path.parent.name), so it gets the same guard plus validate_job_id, and it already catches RuntimeError. Prune's locked re-read (_read_job_at) skips the guard, but slice 05's isinstance check in _prune_reason still covers it. Only files in 'May modify' changed. The updated test expectations match what the handoff allows: not listed, ERROR envelope and exit 1, and a prune skip reason equal to the read_job error while old-done is still removed. New CLI tests for continue and cancel were added. Verification: test_malformed_status and test_prune ran 29 tests, all OK. compileall is clean. Full discover ran 103 tests; the only 4 failures are test_release link checks on .colab/runs/*.md (audit trail, not this change). Only nits remain.
